_doc: The overnight matrix's Q1 combinations C1-C4 (OVERNIGHT_PLAN.md, Fable 2026-11-05 22:05 UTC; the creator's brief 19:55 UTC). Each names a WP-Q1 look (look_variants.json q1_variants) and the render profile; the era picks the light preset (light_presets.json), so every combination renders the same four scenes under the same light. C2 is the default character path for every era cell (Fable 22:06 UTC: Q4's toon Rain frame is not there); C1's toon skin is its own cell. Extensions are used as data (their node groups appended from the shipped .blend; no add-on Python runs). Everything is HYP until Fable and the creator judge the cells.

E4.name: nineteenth century: field camp or street

C1.what: Q1 lit matte shading on cast and set, PBR Neutral, the era preset (front-biased key, two linked rims), Kuwahara 4 + DoF

C2.what: C1's light and finish; the cast keeps its own Blender Studio skin/cloth shading (native_classes), a per-character skin lift

C3.what: C2 with the far ground painted by depth (plate Kuwahara 10, frame Kuwahara 3)
not_in: Brushstroke Tools on the close plane: its operators are add-on Python, refused in the cloud container; the GN-only route (append .brushstroke_tools.surface_fill + curves_to_brushstrokes) is not built yet

C4.what: C1 with Perfectly Normal spherized face normals (converge 0.6) instead of the blur soften
not_in: nikolaj3d Stylized Painterly Shader: $0 on Gumroad, but the download goes through a checkout that takes an email; not done overnight (no new accounts)
